parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can obtain this ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL. The URL format is `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline. You can obtain this ID from the pipeline URL. The URL format is `https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/{pipelineId}/current`.

parameters.name: relObjectType
parameters.description: The resource type to query. The only supported value is `VARIABLE_GROUP`.
